title: BACnet/UDP active identification (no write/control)
description: Identify BACnet building controllers; read/identify only.
detail: Authorized, in-scope. **Active + read/identify allowed; NO WRITE/CONTROL.** 1) UDP 47808; nmap -sU --script bacnet-info to enumerate device/object info. 2) Read properties for identification only; **do not WriteProperty/atomic writes, no reinitialize, no device control** on production. 3) Note exposed building automation and IT/OT segmentation gaps.
